title: AMillionForever Reveals Captivating New EP DISTORTED
htmlContent:
AMillionForever, the rising enigmatic artist from Australia, has once again captivated audiences with the release of his latest EP, DISTORTED. Known for his dynamic fusion of hip-hop, R&B and pop, this latest project is an electrifying journey through his unique sonic landscape.

From humble beginnings to sharing the stage with major international acts, AMillionForever’s journey has been nothing short of remarkable. With his crew, he stormed onto the scene, impressing audiences at the prestigious Red Bull Music Academy. The momentum only accelerated from there, culminating in the debut of his solo single, “Oh it’s Easy”, a track that quickly found its way onto Apple Music’s esteemed New Australia editorial playlist.

Now, in 2024, AMillionForever returns with his latest offering, DISTORTED. This EP is a sonic exploration of the artist’s psyche, delving into the turbulent emotions and experiences that have shaped his journey. Leading the charge is the single “NO CAP”, a bold declaration of AMillionForever’s unapologetic authenticity and resilience.

Reflecting on the inspiration behind DISTORTED, AMillionForever shares, “The EP represents the distorted mental state I’ve faced at several points in my life when I was on a harsh grind and having to deal with the haters, people switching up, the challenges of staying focused. And it was an outlet of various feelings and emotions such as ego, happiness and frustrations that I encountered on my journey and a reminder to always stay hungry, humble and focused/tunnel vision. The vocals are quite aggressive, and the lyrics are raw/no filter infused with hard-hitting beats to represent this state.”DISTORTED is a testament to AMillionForever’s artistic evolution and unwavering dedication to his craft. As he continues to amass a devoted fanbase both nationally and internationally, the EP serves as a glimpse into the boundless potential of this rising star. Experience the raw energy and unbridled passion of DISTORTED now, available on all major streaming platforms. Stream below.
